description:
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying its mana cost.
Dancing from Dark to Dawn's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blinking Spirit spell.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat.
